1.explanation: The <Button> component defined in Button.js contains all of the size‐ and kind‐based class and prop logic, including where a 32 px override for small ghost buttons should be applied. The missing or mis-placed ghostSmallOverride logic (which should inject a style height: '32px' when kind==='ghost' and size==='small' or deprecated small prop is true) lives in this function. No other files introduce height or style overrides for the ghost small button, so fixing it here (either by restoring the ghostSmallOverride block or updating the SCSS/styling import) will address the bug.
1.bug_scenario: The small ghost variant of the Carbon <Button> is rendering at 36 px tall (measured in the screenshot) when it should be forced to 32 px for the small size kind “ghost.” The screenshot shows a ghost button with classes bx--btn--sm bx--btn--ghost measuring 81.5 × 36.

2.explanation: All of the height logic for ghost-small buttons lives in the Button component in packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.js. In earlier versions, the component computed a ghostSmallOverride flag and merged an inline style {height: '32px'} into commonProps when kind==='ghost' && size==='small' (or small===true). In the compressed snapshot of Button.js this override is missing, so small ghost buttons fall back to the CSS for .bx--btn--sm (36px). Restoring the ghostSmallOverride computation and merging the style override into commonProps (or updating the CSS) in this function is the key fix.
2.bug_scenario: When a “ghost” variant Button is rendered with the “small” size (either via size=“small” or the deprecated small prop), it still renders at 36 px tall (the default height for .bx--btn--sm). The screenshot of the Storybook Canvas shows the highlighted button measuring 36 px high, but per design discussion it should be forced down to 32 px tall when kind=“ghost” and size=“small”.
